details: The US Senate Banking Committee passed the CLARITY Act on May 15, advancing the comprehensive crypto market structure bill to a full Senate vote. This legislation aims to define the securities status of crypto assets, regulate trading platforms, and provide legal protections for the DeFi sector. The bill's progression is largely viewed as a significant positive development for the cryptocurrency industry, offering much-needed regulatory clarity.
title: US Senate Committee Advances CLARITY Act for Crypto Regulation

details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a sharp increase in volatility, resulting in approximately $426 million worth of futures positions being forcibly closed across major exchanges within the last 24 hours. These liquidations predominantly affected long positions, which were betting on rising prices, and were triggered by sudden downward price movements in Bitcoin and other major altcoins. This event underscores the inherent risks for traders utilizing leverage in the volatile crypto markets.
title: Over $400 Million in Crypto Long Positions Liquidated in 24 Hours

details: Recent US inflation data has caused a reassessment of expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts in 2026, with some market participants now pricing in potential rate hikes. This macroeconomic environment, marked by persistent inflation concerns, is contributing to a broader risk-off sentiment across asset classes. Consequently, cryptocurrencies have shown a tendency to lag traditional markets like the Nasdaq, as higher interest rates typically make riskier assets less appealing.
title: US Inflation Concerns Reignite Fed Rate Hike Expectations, Impacts Crypto
